description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'BuzzAnniversaryDao' for handling database operations related to employee anniversaries within the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods to retrieve upcoming anniversaries and count them, utilizing query building and pagination.

classes.name: BuzzAnniversaryDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing employee anniversary related database queries within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of upcoming employee anniversaries based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object for upcoming employee anniversaries, applying sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getUpcomingAnniversariesCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of upcoming employee anniversaries matching the filter criteria.
